newsitem.title: USA: Apple South plans 71 new restaurants.
newsitem.headline: Apple South plans 71 new restaurants.

text.p: Apple South Inc, cheered by a 36 percent sales increase in the first quarter of 1997 compared with the same quarter last year, said Monday it plans to open another 71 new restaurants this year.

"We plan to open 71 new restaurants in 1997 and have already opened seven Applebee's Neighborhood Grill and Bar, three Don Pablo's and three Hops Grill & Bar restaurants for a total of 13 during the first quarter," said company chairman Tom DuPree Jr."

The company reported earlier Monday earnings per share during the 1997 quarter of $0.19, compared with the loss of $.14 per share in the 1996 quarter. Earnings for the 1996 quarter, however, were crimped by a $12.7 million ($0.32 per share) after-tax charge for asset revaluations.
Apple South said sales for the three months ended March 30, 1997 jumped to $171.5 million from $126.3 a year earlier.
